name: Project Atlas Distributed Storage
failureOutcome: Pipeline throughput degraded by 48% under concurrent write spikes causing SLA breach.
historicalIntervention: Decoupled asynchronous chunk write-buffering with adaptive backpressure.
interventionOutcome: P99 ingestion latency decreased by 74%, zero cluster halts over 6 months.
sanitizedEvidenceReferences: Incident Postmortem Doc #418 - Chunk queue saturation
Architecture RFC #19 - Asynchronous ingestion ring buffer
keyLessons: Always uncouple streaming ingest network sockets from disk write synchronization.
Implement adaptive token-bucket rate limiting before scaling tenant worker pools.

name: PulseWear Core Onboarding
failureOutcome: 62% user drop-off in first 48 hours due to complex 7-step mandatory biometric calibration.
primaryFailurePattern: Premature Onboarding Friction & High Setup Barrier
historicalIntervention: Shifted to progressive calibration: 1-tap baseline setup followed by background passive learning.
interventionOutcome: Day-7 active user retention increased from 38% to 81%.
sanitizedEvidenceReferences: Q2 Funnel Analytics Report - Step 3 friction dropoff
UX Review Study - User calibration abandonment
keyLessons: Never mandate full feature configuration during initial user activation.
Calibrate complex machine learning baselines progressively from passive usage.
